title: Measure Before You Train: Typed Decision Models vs. a Classical Baseline vs. a Generative LLM for Routing a Personal Multilingual Inbox
abstract: arXiv:2610.32955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal email agents decide, for every message, what it is, whether it is urgent, whether to draft a reply, create a task, or ignore it. Their error rate is rarely measured: the stored labels were written by the system itself. We present Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent in daily use, and a measurement protocol (stratified sampling, frozen snapshots, thread-grouped splits, pre-registered hypotheses, human labels in the agent's review loop) that yields ground truth before any training. On 739 real Italian/English emails labelled by the owner (231 unbiased, 500 adversarially sampled), we compare nine systems under thread-grouped cross-validation: the production keyword rules, a TF-IDF + logistic-regression baseline, local typed decision models (Tev1, Nimble), a hosted decision model (Nimble v4-max), and hosted generative LLMs (Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma 4 26B/31B). Four results. The production rules score 28% on message type against a 58%

translated_title: 先测量再训练：类型化决策模型 vs. 经典基线 vs. 生成式大语言模型在个人多语言收件箱路由中的应用
translated_abstract: 个人邮件代理需要为每封邮件做出决策：这封邮件属于什么类型、是否紧急、是否需要起草回复、创建任务，还是直接忽略。然而这些系统的错误率很少被真正测量，因为存储的标签是由系统自身生成的。我们提出了Foyer——一个正在日常使用的自托管个人收件箱代理，以及一套测量协议（分层采样、冻结快照、按邮件线程分组的划分、预注册假设、在代理审查循环中由人工标注），该协议能够在任何训练开始之前获得真实标注数据。在739封由所有者亲自标注的真实意大利语/英语邮件上（其中231封为无偏样本，500封为对抗性采样），我们在按线程分组的交叉验证下比较了九个系统：生产环境的关键词规则、TF-IDF+逻辑回归经典基线、本地类型化决策模型、托管决策模型，以及托管生成式大语言模型。论文给出了四项主要结果，其中生产环境规则在邮件类型识别上仅获得28%的得分，而对照系统达到了58%。
tldr: 该论文提出自托管个人邮件代理Foyer及其测量协议，在真实多语言邮件数据上于训练前建立人工真实标注基准，并系统比较了类型化决策模型、经典机器学习基线与生成式大语言模型等九个系统的表现。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Foyer, a self-hosted personal inbox agent, and a measurement protocol that establishes human ground-truth labels before any training, systematically comparing nine systems—including typed decision models, a classical baseline, and generative LLMs—on real multilingual emails.
